overlapWindow.basis: Previous successful per-ecosystem full-content checkpoint minus24h; modified OR published. Complete canonical comparison also detects retroactive changes regardless of timestamps.

scope.ingestionPolicy: Only id/aliases define identity. MAL, informational notices, out-of-window records and unresolved identifiers are separate. Existing curated content preserved.
scope.baselineRetrievalNote: All seven retained previous ZIPs verified against saved byte counts and SHA256, then fully CRC-read and canonical-compared. Immutable generation recovery URLs remain recorded. Previous dated audit files unchanged.

osv.canonicalComparisonMethod: Full canonical JSON SHA256 for every CRC-read archive entry; global source ID comparisons use canonical variant sets, plus per-ecosystem exact comparison.

newChangedOutsideReviewedCandidates.summary: Decompression bomb in `ruzstd`: a tiny input can exhaust memory (OOM)

ingestionResolution.note: Existing89 curated files remain byte-identical. Supplemental9 are earlier publications. Ruzstd lacks verified supported mainID; vLLM range/fix uncertain; both retained as candidates.

compressionNote: Deterministic lossless gzip with compressed/uncompressed SHA256 receipts. Full archives reproducible using immutable generation URL and checksum.

cisaKev.note: One ordinary official fresh GET returned 403. No retry, bypass, alternate host, or catalog conclusion. Existing unknown/unverified status and null successful-fetch watermark preserved.

jvnAuditSummary.conclusion: Complete Oct 12–14 JST MyJVN modification window: 137 distinct all-product rows. The 16 selected library rows comprise 7 existing Reviewed aliases, 8 independently verified package proposals and 1 unresolved vLLM candidate. The 19 prior candidates and 241 historical rows are retained. Three official feeds include 2 new unique notices (AssetView and Thelia), both outside the seven-ecosystem library scope. Eight Elastic server-product notices receive no inferred client-library mapping. KEV remains unknown/unverified after one HTTP 403.
